descriptive_title: Grade 3 Mathematics: Algebra (Coding) — Sequential, Concurrent, and Repeating Events Without Screens (C3.1-C3.2)
short_description: A 5-day Ontario Grade-3 unit on coding without screens (C3.1-C3.2) framed around 'Bug Busters' — Buzz the Bug-Buster Beetle and Patch the Repair Pup. Concurrent events, finding bugs, fixing bugs, and a capstone bug-buster project.
long_description: Children spend a focused week as Junior Bug Busters. Day 1 introduces concurrent events. Day 2 writes 2-lane code with concurrent events and loops (C3.1). Day 3 finds bugs in existing code (C3.2). Day 4 fixes bugs by altering code (C3.2). Day 5 closes with child-invented capstone projects where partners plant and fix bugs. Each lesson includes an expanded_walkthrough.
what_is_included: 5 fully-scripted lesson plans with 50-minute durations and 250 minutes of total teaching time
5 student worksheets aligned to each lesson

10 printable teacher manipulatives plus 2 character puppets: 2-lane grid mat, code step cards (30), buggy code cards (12), robot markers, concurrent vs sequential chart, capstone template, loop cards (8), code alteration cards (8), bug type chart, bug busters poster, plus stick-puppet variants of Buzz and Patch
1 end-of-unit reflection sheet with 5 self-assessment prompts
1 two-row summative rubric covering C3.1-C3.2 across 4 levels
1 summative-administration guide tying the rubric to Lesson 5 capstone
Junior Bug Buster certificate (one per child)
Detailed expanded walkthroughs covering common misconceptions
Differentiation tracks built into every lesson
target_buyer: Ontario Grade 3 teachers covering the C3.1-C3.2 cluster — coding with concurrent events.
subject: Mathematics
pedagogical_approach: CRA progression. The 2-lane grid mat is the anchor — children execute concurrent code with 2 robots. Lessons 1-2 introduce concurrent events. Lessons 3-4 introduce bug finding and fixing. Lesson 5 closes with a child-invented capstone.
